name: Operations Home
description: The operations home of a weather service: season earnings, recent sign-ups, revenue by week, month or year, a year of bulletins and a customers table, all filtered by region.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person at the foot of the sidebar. The greeting uses the first name.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Portrait images keyed by person name, used for the user and the recent sign-ups. Anyone without one shows initials.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
